summary: FT-033 rev 4: searched wider than rev 3 for a consumer (repo-wide grep plus crates/document-runtime, crates/compiler, apps/mac by hand) -- still none; document-runtime is a JSON-Lines compiler transport with no layout concern, compiler's parser records Parsed::document_class but has no title/author/date/maketitle handling at all (not in its BUILT_INS table), apps/mac is a Swift protocol client with no Rust to integrate against. Built a consumer-integration fixture anyway (crates/title-layout/tests/consumer_integration.rs, 4 tests) against the closest real callers, as dev-dependencies only: flashtex_compiler::parser::parse run over a real tests/tex-corpus fixture feeds DocumentClass::parse with the real Parsed::document_class string (accept-article and reject-report paths, both through the real parser); a new RealFaceMetrics implements GlyphMetrics over a real flashtex_font_engine::Face (Latin Modern Roman OTF loaded from the local BasicTeX install, skipped not failed if absent -- same file/path as font-engine's own tests/latin_modern.rs), mirroring font-engine's own adapters::paragraph::FaceMetrics pattern since font-engine has no title-layout adapter to reuse. Cross-checked the crate's computed title width against an independent sum of the same real face's advances, and confirmed a real missing glyph (Latin Modern has no CJK) still produces MissingGlyphMetric, never a substituted width. Measured rev 3's three named gaps against tests/tex-corpus (the repo's only real .tex corpus, 14 documents/16 files): 14/14 declare a supported class (article), 0/14 declare an unsupported one, and 0/14 use a title block at all (no \title/\author/\date/\maketitle anywhere in the corpus) -- so two-column/lineskip/listparindent hit-counts are all 0/0 by construction; the corpus has no title-block coverage to hit those gaps with, which is the real top finding, not any one named gap dominating. Full table and exact grep commands in coordination/daniel-title.md. cargo test: 50 tests + 1 doctest, all pass (2 of the 4 new tests skip with a message on a machine without the BasicTeX font install). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean. cargo fmt --check: clean.
next_action: Await Commander integration; still no consumer wiring (none exists). A future consumer needs: (1) compiler's document_class to carry \documentclass[options] through if it wants non-default ClassOptions, (2) something to extract \title/\author/\date bodies (nothing in the repo does today), and (3) a GlyphMetrics impl returning only None or a finite non-negative Pt.

FT-033.adaptation: Searched crates/document-runtime, crates/compiler, apps/mac by hand (not just a repo grep) before concluding again that no consumer exists, per the revision's explicit instruction to look harder and wider. Since no real consumer exists to integrate against, built the fixture against the most faithful real callers available instead: flashtex-compiler's real parser output and a real flashtex-font-engine::Face, added as dev-dependencies only (library code unchanged, still depends on nothing but flashtex-document-style), following font-engine's own adapters::paragraph::FaceMetrics pattern from title-layout's side without editing font-engine. Measured the three gaps rev 3 only listed against tests/tex-corpus with exact grep-based counts rather than restating them qualitatively, and reported the corpus's actual top finding (no title-block usage at all, so the three gaps can't manifest against it) rather than forcing one of the three named gaps to look dominant.
